page.layout: One page of text in a single column. A marginal note in the right margin beside the start of the chapter. Printed page number at the top right corner.

main_text.p: trā, qui non habet Filium Dei, alienus est à vitæ æternæ spe: cum nullus sit alius salutis, nisi hic unicus nobis à Deo constitutus auctor; ac proinde frustra salus extra hunc Servatorem speratur. Ergò & Patres Veteris Testamenti, qui vitam habent æternam, eam per CHRISTUM Filium DEI habent. Unde tandem vel maximè elucet orthodoxæ sententiæ veritas, quæ præcipuum fructum mortis Christi, non in confirmatione doctrinæ salutis, sed in merito & satisfactione constituit.
main_text.head: CAPUT VII.

head.i: ASSERTIO ET DEMONSTRATIO Meriti et satisfactionis Jesu Christi, ex eo, quod Christi obedientia nobis imputatur ad justitiam; quòd seviro Dei judicio fuerit satisfaciendum; quòd Christus non peccator sit mortuus.

main_text.p: {M}MEDIATOREM, Reconcili-atorem & Redemtorem nostrum JESUM CHRISTUM esse Servatorem nostrum, Merito & satisfactione pro pec-TRIAS Argumen-torum quam tn.

page.notes: Drop-cap M of "MEDIATOREM" is a large woodcut initial; reconstructed from the visible letters "EDIATOREM". The right-margin note is small and partly cut off; "quam" and the last word are doubtful. The page number "243" at top right is printed in an old style and is doubtful. The word "seviro" in the chapter title is doubtful and is likely "sevęro" in the original; the printed form has been read as seviro. The running head right side ("tff") is a printed page-number variant and is not transcribed as text. No catchword or signature is visible at the foot.
